quest.title: A Moment's Respite
quest.description: The crisis has been averted... for now. You decide to return to the Fortress of Meropide to see how everyone's doing.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x775, Primogem x30, Mora x34075, Memory of Running Stream x1, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Return to the prison to learn more about everyone's situation

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sigewinne!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, you're back!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Are you still doing alright? Did either of you get hurt?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, we're both doing great.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're fine! But what about you guys? It was such a huge mess! How bad was it?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: A few people sustained superficial injuries, but that's about the extent of the damage. Monsieur Neuvillette paid us a visit. It was all thanks to him that we managed to suppress the crisis for the time being.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Of course, we must also thank you for the help you provided.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How did Neuvillette know that he was needed here?

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette has strong resonance with the Hydro element. When the water level rises, he can feel the waves produced.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I ran into the Bombshell Bros while bandaging the injuries of the wounded. They were mumbling the whole time about how you just ran down without a word... I'm so relieved to see that you're both alright.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: If you're not too pressed for time, please stay with us a few more days.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Just let me know if you get a craving for any particular dish, so I can have Mr. Wolsey get your meals prepared. Oh, and please feel free to visit the infirmary for a break at any time.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I'd like to take the opportunity to spend some more time observing your facial muscles as well. Your happy smiles are quite contagious, you know. They're so memorable, and I've missed them immensely while you were gone.

talks.objective: Return to the prison to learn more about everyone's situation

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Now guess! What suit will this next card be?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Uhhh... A bared-teeth cat?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Well, well, look who it is.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Hello everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like you're recovering nicely, Freminet!

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Mhm, thanks to everyone's support.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Oh, right! I... I managed to work up the courage to thank Miss Clorinde in person!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, how did she react?

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: She told me that it was nothing... It was as if saving a life wasn't a big deal to her at all. She also told me to not worry about it.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: She didn't want to stress you out, that's all. She's right, and it's best not to dwell on it.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: Yeah...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, but check this out! We went back to the opera house, and we met The Knave!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: You met "Father"? Did she say anything to you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She said a few things that were... uh, a bit hard to understand, and also that she's looking forward to working with us in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was a little surprising.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Her attitude towards you is even better than what we'd imagined... That's fantastic.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: You should believe her. She has her own way of doing things, and she'll do everything in her power to help those she considers close, which now might also include you.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Mhm. "Father" is very capable, and also trustworthy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon just remembered that she thought Lyney was a bit too proud as well! She said that you should learn how to rely on others sometimes.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Uh... Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: That does sound like something that "Father" would say...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Hey!

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Are you going to stay here for the next few days?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like it, yeah.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Excellent. I will host a tea party.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: For real? Then Paimon wants another serving of cake!

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Another implies that you were already served some delicious cake while you were up there. Hmm, how lovely.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Well next time, you're going to have tea and snacks with us.

talks.objective: Return to the prison to learn more about everyone's situation

dialogues.speaker: Cuistot
dialogues.text: Eh? You... You guys are back?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cuistot! Laverune!

dialogues.speaker: Laverune
dialogues.text: You guys... didn't get caught and thrown back down here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? No, not at all!

dialogues.speaker: Cuistot
dialogues.text: Ugh! And here I thought you'd managed to escape from jail during all the commotion. I had held you up as legendary jailbreakers, but now you're telling me... you just never left?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahahaha... Uh, we're sorry, but we just... Had some business to take care of...

dialogues.speaker: Laverune
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, there's no need to get caught up in the details. We're just relieved to see you. He was super worried about you, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Cuistot
dialogues.text: Hey, it wasn't just me! Weren't you super worried as well?

dialogues.speaker: Laverune
dialogues.text: Something like that, yeah.

dialogues.speaker: Laverune
dialogues.text: I was also transferred to work in the kitchen a few days ago. I can still hear Cuistot mumbling to the carrots: "Are those two alright? Do you think they made it out alive?"

dialogues.speaker: Laverune
dialogues.text: Whenever he said that, I'd tell him, "I'm sure they're fine! Wherever they are, they're kicking back with drinks in hand, enjoying the lovely scenery."

dialogues.speaker: Cuistot
dialogues.text: Hey! There's nothing wrong with worrying about your prison pals, is there? I mean, considering how they always loved listening to all of my gossip...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These two... They sure are a lot warmer and friendlier than when Paimon first met them...

choices.text: I'm sure the welfare meals must have just skyrocketed in quality recently.

response.speaker: Cuistot
response.text: ...Well, if you say so. I'll be watching you to make sure you finish every last bite!

choices.text: Your meals will bring all the prisoners to the cafeteria.

talks.objective: Return to the prison to learn more about everyone's situation

dialogues.speaker: Lourvine
dialogues.text: Jurieu! Miss Sigewinne told me you still haven't eaten.

dialogues.speaker: Jurieu
dialogues.text: Er, I was working on something, so I forgot.

dialogues.speaker: Lourvine
dialogues.text: That's no excuse for... Huh? It's you two!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jurieu, Lourvine, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Jurieu
dialogues.text: Hello there. It's been quite the mess here recently. How have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're fine, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And you? Are you still taking the secret passageway from the infirmary to work on the ship?

dialogues.speaker: Lourvine
dialogues.text: Yep. That is still top secret, though. So don't say a word to anyone!

dialogues.speaker: Jurieu
dialogues.text: It can be a bit annoying when there are lots of people in the infirmary, but I still prefer taking that route over the one from the Duke's office.

dialogues.speaker: Lourvine
dialogues.text: I mean, the infirmary does make it easier for you to slack off.

dialogues.speaker: Jurieu
dialogues.text: Oh yeah? Then why are you also here so much?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You two really are just using your jobs as a cover for your relationship, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Together
dialogues.text: Not at all!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Do my eyes deceive me or did I just see two inmates come back after making it to the surface? Some strange winds blowing of late.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We wanted to see how the Fortress is doing! Is everything still alright?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: We're fine for the most part. Neuvillette came down and took care of the worst of it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If that's the case, why don't you just ask him to stay here?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, what a brilliant plan. Let's go convince the Iudex himself to exchange the courts of Fontaine for a puddle of water in the middle of nowhere.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think that's going to work...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: He came here in a hurry, and left without even stopping for a cup of tea. He did remember to take Miss Sigewinne's gift with him, though.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He sure sounds super busy.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Miss Clorinde has left as well. She also took her gift from Miss Sigewinne.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Were the gifts milkshakes?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Neuvillette got the milkshake. Clorinde received lipstick instead.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Those aren't even remotely alike!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Well, it's Neuvillette's own fault for making Sigewinne worried about his health by working so much. But besides that, our head nurse is still pretty fond of picking out beauty products for the ladies.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Oh, and I have some gifts here for you as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are these from Sigewinne, too?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Nope, they are from yours truly.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: You've already wrapped up your work at the Fortress, so you can return to the surface at any time. You haven't yet served your full prison term, however, so you may continue to use your cell until your term is up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: For real? Then we can stay here for a really long time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is food still covered?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: You may access the cafeteria for free.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hooray!

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Just remember to come complete your paperwork once it's time for your release.

talks.objective: Return to the dormitories to rest

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back in our cell again! We're no longer prisoners, though, so it really doesn't feel the same...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It feels like a huge weight is off our shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure feels that way... But the truth is, we never did anything bad to begin with, so I'm not sure why we put so much pressure on ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It feels like we've regained our freedom.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mhm! Being free sure feels pretty special now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, is there something you'd like to say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How did you know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Because you usually just immediately fall asleep.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, that's not true! Alright... Okay, Paimon just wanted to say that we really are an amazing duo after all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's like... We've now gone to so many places together, and become friends with so many people. We've never stopped traveling, or stopped meeting new friends.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are so many bad things in the world, and we're just two people, but we've still been solving problems no matter where we go... Isn't that pretty cool?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're the best adventurers ever.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're counting Paimon today? Aren't you the only adventurer here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Being a guide counts, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then let's ask Katheryne to give Paimon an Adventurer Handbook as well! Paimon'll also be an adventurer from today forward!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh, just the thought's making Paimon giddy... Paimon's gonna crash, so you sleep soon, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The last time we fell asleep here, we woke up to a whole mess outside our cell. The Primordial Seawater nearly rose up. That was so scary...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should be safe now, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll be fine, so don't worry, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Alright, then good night to you, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night to you, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: If you can find the time, please stay at the Fortress for just a while longer.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: We should start preparing that tea party!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Oh! That's a great idea. I'm all for it.

dialogues.speaker: Freminet
dialogues.text: I'll help you set it up.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Your file can't be closed until we've completed your paperwork, so don't forget to come find me again when you're done serving your sentence.

dialogues.speaker: Cuistot
dialogues.text: Why don't we have a meal with those two one of these days?

dialogues.speaker: Laverune
dialogues.text: You wanna cook for 'em yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Cuistot
dialogues.text: Why not? Good chance to show them what I can do.

dialogues.speaker: Lourvine
dialogues.text: Jurieu, the rumors about us are literally everywhere now. Please do something about it.

dialogues.speaker: Jurieu
dialogues.text: But it's not like I caused them by myself... Alright, alright, I'll try to do something about it when I can find the time.
